additional_info.subject: Case note
additional_info.body: “EVSE_TempLowerLimit” error flag active even though in the location the temperature is not cold, since the error flag should activate only if the internal temperature is under -25°C for more than 5 seconds. What could be a reason for this error? Loose connection or something else?

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0386305 - DC/Si-D/FI - [foRGhQ] - EVSE_TempLowerLimit CRM:01811000401
additional_info.body:
Hello Markus,
Hope you are doing well.
Based on our analysis of the logs, we have identified two or three potential reasons for triggering the EVSE_TempLowerLimit error flag. We need to perform on-site checks, Here are the possible causes and necessary actions:
Faulty Temperature Sensor
: Please arrange for a spare BT1 sensor to have on hand while troubleshooting on-site.
Loose Connection
: Check for any loose connections to the BT1 sensor that may be causing it to report faulty values.
Wiring Mismatch
: We can also troubleshoot any mismatches in wiring related to the temperature and humidity wires while on-site.
Check
the connection of the circuit mentioned below:
For further narrow down the root cause, we should enable Debug mode for this charger. If possible, please arrange for an EV to be charged during this visit, so we can check the temperature and humidity values of the individual BT sensors and see if the values are swapped.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
ANKITA
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
